body = '''def records(row):
    return [('ok', item['framing'], item['body']['n'], item['start'], item['end'],
             item['host_count'], item['flags']) for item in row['requests']]


def shape(row):
    if row['error'] is not None:
        return ('error', row['error']['kind'], row['error']['offset'])
    return records(row)


def full(row):
    return (records(row),
            None if row['error'] is None else (row['error']['kind'], row['error']['offset']))


UN = ['unattributed']
MH = ['missing_host', 'unattributed']

check('simple request', shape(channel_blob(SIMPLE)),
      [('ok', 'none', 0, 0, 28, 1, UN)])
check('empty channel', shape(channel_blob(b'')), [])
check('two requests', shape(channel_blob(SIMPLE + SIMPLE)),

# request line

    check('request line %r' % blob[:30], shape(channel_blob(blob)), want)

# first line completeness
check('short no LF', shape(channel_blob(b'GET /a HTTP/1.1')), ('error', 'incomplete', 0))
for amount, want in [(8193, ('error', 'incomplete', 0)), (8194, ('error', 'syntax', 0))]:
    doc = {'seed': 's', 'definitions': [['L', 'b"A" * %d' % amount]], 'timeout_ms': 1,

    check('no LF %d' % amount, shape(run(doc)['channels'][0]), want)
check('CR at end', full(channel_blob(SIMPLE + b'GET /a HTTP/1.1\\r')),

check('CR then non-LF', shape(channel_blob(SIMPLE + b'GET /a HTTP/1.1\\rX')),
      ('error', 'incomplete', 28))
check('bare LF after request', shape(channel_blob(SIMPLE + b'\\n')), ('error', 'syntax', 28))
check('LF without CR', shape(channel_blob(b'GET /a HTTP/1.1\\n')), ('error', 'syntax', 0))
check('line too long then LF',

check('line at limit', shape(channel_blob(

                   (b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-_.~`|!#$%&*+: v\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                    [('ok', 'none', 0, 0, 38, 0, MH)])]:
    check('field %r' % blob[16:34], shape(channel_blob(blob)), want)

# field count and block size limits
check('128 fields', shape(channel_blob(
    b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n' + b'X: y\\r\\n' * 128 + b'\\r\\n'))[0][0], 'ok')
check('129 fields', shape(channel_blob(
    b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n' + b'X: y\\r\\n' * 129 + b'\\r\\n')), ('error', 'syntax', 0))
pad = b'X: ' + b'y' * (8192 - 3) + b'\\r\\n'
body = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n'
while len(body) + len(pad) + 2 <= 65536:
    body += pad
body += b'Y: ' + b'z' * (65536 - len(body) - 2 - 3 - 2) + b'\\r\\n'
check('block exactly 65536', len(body) + 2, 65536)
check('block at limit', shape(channel_blob(body + b'\\r\\n'))[0][0], 'ok')
check('block over limit', shape(channel_blob(body + b'\\r\\n' + b'Z: 1\\r\\n\\r\\n')),

for value, want in [(b'5', 'ok'), (b'05', 'ok'), (b' 5 ', 'ok'), (b'5,5', 'ok'),

                    (b'0x5', 'syntax'), (b'5,', 'syntax'), (b',5', 'syntax'),
                    (b' 5 , 5 ', 'ok'), (b'5 6', 'syntax'), (b'+5', 'syntax'),
                    (b'-5', 'syntax'), (b'9223372036854775807', 'ok'),
                    (b'9223372036854775808', 'syntax'), (b'0' * 5000, 'ok'),
                    (b'9' * 4400, 'syntax'), (b'5\\t,\\t5', 'ok')]:

    if want == 'ok':
        got = 'ok' if isinstance(result, list) and result[0][1] == 'length' else result

    check('content-length %r' % value[:24], got, want)

check('duplicate CL fields agree', shape(channel_blob(

check('duplicate CL fields differ', shape(channel_blob(

check('length body opaque', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nContent-Length: 18\\r\\n\\r\\nGET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n')),
    [('ok', 'length', 18, 0, 59, 0, MH)])
check('insufficient body', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nContent-Length: 24\\r\\n\\r\\nshort')), ('error', 'incomplete', 0))
check('no CL means empty body', full(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\n\\r\\nleftover')),
    ([('ok', 'none', 0, 0, 28, 1, UN)], ('incomplete', 28)))

# transfer-encoding
for value, want in [(b'chunked', 'chunked'), (b'CHUNKED', 'chunked'),
                    (b' chunked ', 'chunked'), (b'\\tchunked', 'chunked'),
                    (b'gzip', 'syntax'), (b'chunked, gzip', 'syntax'),
                    (b'', 'syntax'), (b'chunked;q=1', 'syntax'),
                    (b'chunked,chunked', 'syntax')]:
    blob = b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: ' + value + b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n'
    result = shape(channel_blob(blob))
    got = result[0][1] if isinstance(result, list) else result[1]
    check('transfer-encoding %r' % value, got, want)
check('TE with CL', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\nContent-Length: 0\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n')),
    ('error', 'syntax', 0))
check('two TE', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n')),
    ('error', 'syntax', 0))

# chunked bodies
check('basic chunked', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n5\\r\\nhello\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n')),

check('chunked uppercase hex', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\nA\\r\\n0123456789\\r\\n0000000\\r\\n\\r\\n'))[0][2], 10)
check('chunked extension', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n3;a=b;c\\r\\nddd\\r\\n0;x\\r\\n\\r\\n'))[0][2], 3)
check('chunked empty extension', shape(channel_blob(

check('chunked zero chunk only', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n'))[0][2], 0)

      {'n': 44, 'h': '%016x' % hash_bytes(

          + (1).to_bytes(8, 'big') + b'Z' + (1).to_bytes(8, 'big') + b'w')})
for blob, want in [(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'incomplete'),

                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n', 'incomplete'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\nX: y\\r\\n', 'incomplete'),

                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n5\\r\\nabcde', 'incomplete'),

                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n5\\r\\nabcde\\r', 'incomplete')]:
    base = b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked'
    check('chunked tail %r' % blob, shape(channel_blob(base + blob)), ('error', want, 0))
for blob, want in [(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n5\\r\\nabcdefg\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n5\\r\\nabcdeX\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n5\\nabcde\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n 5\\r\\nabcde\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n5 \\r\\nabcde\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\nabcde\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\nzz\\r\\nabcde\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n5;x\\x01\\r\\nabcde\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\nContent-Length: 1\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\nTRANSFER-ENCODING: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\nbogus\\r\\n\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n' + b'X: y\\r\\n' * 129 + b'\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n' + b'X: y\\r\\n' * 128 + b'\\r\\n', 'ok'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n7fffffffffffffffff\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n10000000000000000\\r\\n', 'syntax'),
                   (b'\\r\\n\\r\\n7fffffffffffffff\\r\\n', 'incomplete')]:
    base = b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked'
    check('chunked bad %r' % blob[-24:], shape(channel_blob(base + blob)), ('error', want, 0))
trailer = b'POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n0\\r\\n' + b'X: ' + b'y' * 8189 + b'\\r\\n\\r\\n'
check('trailer block at limit', shape(channel_blob(trailer))[0][1], 'chunked')
trailer += b'Z: 1\\r\\n'
check('trailer block over limit', shape(channel_blob(trailer)), ('error', 'syntax', 0))

# host handling and records
row = channel_blob(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: Example.COM \\r\\n\\r\\n')['requests'][0]
check('host trimmed lowercased', row['host'],
      {'n': 11, 'h': '%016x' % hash_bytes(b'example.com')})
row = channel_blob(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: \\r\\n\\r\\n')['requests'][0]
check('empty host value', (row['host_count'], row['host']['n']), (1, 0))
row = channel_blob(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: a\\r\\nhost: a\\r\\n\\r\\n')['requests'][0]
check('multiple host', (row['host_count'], row['host'], row['flags']),
      (2, {'n': 0, 'h': '0000000000000000'}, ['multiple_host'] + UN))
row = channel_blob(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n')['requests'][0]
check('headers empty block', row['headers'],

check('no extra request keys', sorted(row),
      ['body', 'end', 'flags', 'framing', 'headers', 'host', 'host_count', 'method',
       'owner', 'owners', 'start', 'target', 'trailers'])
check('bytes fingerprint', channel_blob(SIMPLE)['bytes'],
      {'n': 28, 'h': '%016x' % hash_bytes(SIMPLE)})

# multi-part channels

      ([1, 2, 2], {'kind': 'incomplete', 'offset': 56}))
